00044 NeuralPatternSimpleInternal::NeuralPatternSimpleInternal(NumericalArray<float> const& _inputVector,
00045                              NumericalArray<float> const& _outputVector) throw()
00046 : inputVector(_inputVector.copy()),

00051 void NeuralPatternSimpleInternal::write(TextFileWriter const& _file) const throw()
00052 {
00053   const int size = 128;
00054   char buf[size];
00055   
00056   TextFileWriter file = _file;
00057   
00058   file.write("\nNeuralPatternSimple:v1\n");
00059   
00060   const int numInputs = inputVector.size();
00061   snprintf(buf, size, "Inputs:%3d\n", numInputs);
00062   file.write(buf);
00063   
00064   const float *inputVectorArray = inputVector.getArray();
00065   for(int i = 0; i < numInputs; i++)
00066   {
00067     snprintf(buf, size, "%3d %.16f\n", i, inputVectorArray[i]);
00068     file.write(buf);
00069   }
00070   
00071   const int numOutputs = outputVector.size();
00072   snprintf(buf, size, "Outputs:%3d", numOutputs);
00073   file.write(buf);
00074   
00075   const float *outputVectorArray = outputVector.getArray();
00076   for(int i = 0; i < numOutputs; i++)
00077   {
00078     file.write("\n");
00079     snprintf(buf, size, "%3d %.16f", i, outputVectorArray[i]);
00080     file.write(buf);
00081   }
00082 }

00084 void NeuralPattern::read(TextFileReader const& _file) throw()
00085 {
00086   TextFileReader file = _file;
00087   
00088   Text text;
00089   int line = 0;
00090   int numInputs = -1, numOutputs = -1;
00091     
00092   NumericalArray<float> inputVector;
00093   NumericalArray<float> outputVector;
00094   
00095   while((text = file.readLine()).size() != 0)
00096   {
00097     if(line == 0)
00098     {
00099       // should be the format/version string
00100       if(text.contains("NeuralPatternSimple:v1") == false)
00101       {
00102         printf("NeuralPattern::read wrong version type\n");
00103         return;
00104       }
00105     }
00106     else if(numInputs < 0)
00107     {
00108       // should be the number of inputs     
00109       sscanf(text.getArray(), "Inputs:%d", &numInputs);
00110       
00111       if(numInputs < 1) 
00112       {
00113         printf("NeuralPattern::read invalid number of inputs\n");
00114         return;
00115       }
00116       
00117       //printf("ins: %d\n", numInputs);
00118       
00119       inputVector = NumericalArray<float>::withSize(numInputs);
00120     }
00121     else if(numInputs > 0)
00122     {
00123       int index;
00124       float value;
00125       sscanf(text.getArray(), "%d %f", &index, &value);
00126       numInputs--;
00127       
00128       //printf("in[%3d] = %f\n", index, value);
00129       
00130       inputVector[index] = value;
00131     }
00132     else if(numOutputs < 0)
00133     {
00134       // should be the number of outputs      
00135       sscanf(text.getArray(), "Outputs:%d", &numOutputs);
00136       
00137       if(numOutputs < 1) 
00138       {
00139         printf("NeuralPattern::read invalid number of numOutputs\n");
00140         return;
00141       }
00142       
00143       //printf("outs: %d\n", numOutputs);
00144       
00145       outputVector = NumericalArray<float>::withSize(numOutputs);
00146     }
00147     else if(numOutputs > 0)
00148     {
00149       int index;
00150       float value;
00151       sscanf(text.getArray(), "%d %f", &index, &value);
00152       numOutputs--;
00153       
00154       //printf("out[%3d] = %f\n", index, value);
00155       
00156       outputVector[index] = value;
00157     }
00158     
00159     if((numInputs == 0) && (numOutputs == 0))
00160     {
00161       //printf("CREATING PATTERN\n");
00162       setInternal(new NeuralPatternSimpleInternal(inputVector, outputVector));
00163       return;
00164     }
00165     
00166     line++;
00167   }   
00168 }

00170 void NeuralPatternArray::write(TextFileWriter const& _file) const throw()
00171 { 
00172   TextFileWriter file = _file;
00173   
00174   const NeuralPattern* array = getArray();
00175   
00176   if(array != 0)
00177   {
00178     file.write("NeuralPatternArray:v1");
00179     
00180     const int numPatterns = size();
00181     for(int i = 0; i < numPatterns; i++)
00182     {
00183       array[i].write(file);
00184     }
00185   }
00186 }
00187 void NeuralPatternArray::read(TextFileReader const& _file) throw()
00188 {
00189   TextFileReader file = _file;
00190   
00191   Text text = file.readLine();
00192   
00193   if(text.contains("NeuralPatternArray:v1"))
00194   {
00195     //printf("is valid NeuralPatternArray file\n");
00196     
00197     while(file.isEof() == false)
00198     {
00199       NeuralPattern pat;
00200       pat.read(file);
00201       
00202       if((pat.getNumInputs() > 0) && (pat.getNumOutputs() > 0))
00203       {
00204         //printf("..adding a pattern..\n");
00205         
00206         this->add(pat);
00207       }
00208     }
00209   }
